about: Hangar access equipment for A320 maintenance (to-do 364 A). Our own models, no brands. +y faces the aircraft; pivots are in metres, Blender z-up (the importer mirrors x). Mechanics push each piece out of the tow path before a tow and back after (push IK points, braked castors). Every control the player works is its own part with an IK hand or foot point. Built by Art/HangarEquipment/*/make_*.py with hq_lib.py. No game code yet.
